courses.synopsis: Machine inspection, rate of wear and replacement time prediction. Basic technologies and equipment for repairs of internal combustion engines, pumps and small output power generating plants, machine tools, vehicles, earth-moving equipment and lifting devices. Special techniques in machine repairs. Planning and organization of service and maintenance shops. Planning of the spares stock and related problems.
